title: Chapter 434
paragraphs: Chapter 434
Episode 125. Attackers, Brothers (2)
The Tona brothers were fishing on a small uninhabited island near Tican.
They had hidden their weapons in the boat and were wearing straw hats while disguised, making them look like commoners.
"When can we finally meet the youngest one?"
As Heytona spoke, a fish bit the bait.
Plop, plop.
As the fishing float shook, Daytona quickly pulled the fishing rod.
The delightful arc drawn by the seawater and fishing line in the air should have signaled a catch, but what they held in their hands was a lonely, small piranha.
Seeing the floundering piranha, the Tona brothers lost their appetite.
"It seems like the youngest has become too big of a figure for the likes of us to casually meet."
They carefully removed the hook and released the piranha back into the sea.
Of course, that piranha could not belong to the protagonists of this vast ocean.
Among all kinds of predators, including whales and sharks, it was just a small creature whose existence was hardly noticeable.
No matter how fiercely it struggled, it would be difficult for it to survive, let alone become the ruler of the sea.
That's why the Tona brothers felt like they saw themselves in the sight of the swimming piranha.
Lately, the two had felt a stronger sense of crisis than before.
They were treated as less than air among the Sonwi brothers, and they had never received even a shred of expectation from Shiron and Rosa.
At least the youngest showed interest in them, so they wanted to get closer.

Rather than wanting to secure a place in the family using the youngest's power, as Nanny Emma said, or to receive help for survival, they simply wanted to have a conversation without any particular meaning.
It was an unconscious desire to receive encouragement and consolation from an admired figure.
However, the Tona brothers didn't know what kind of emotion that was. No one had ever told them that people naturally feel such emotions when they are tired and exhausted.
The place where the brothers were born and raised was Runecandel.

"Well, the youngest isn't someone we can meet without a special reason. But even after meeting, there's a problem. When asked why we came, saying we just thought of him would make us look pathetic, right?"
"But that's the truth."
"Sigh, if only we hadn't messed around so much when we were young, the youngest might have thought of us more favorably."
"Back then, we were both fearless."
Their gaze was drawn to Tican Free City, rising high above the blue sea beyond the fishing rod.
That tower-like island was the shining base the youngest had created.
It seemed more meaningful to belong to that island rather than Runecandel. They thought it would be difficult for them to gain any significant value in the Sword Garden anyway.

"......Let's just go back. Even if we meet the youngest like this, we'll only end up disappointing him more. We were going to tell him we just came to see him without any special reason, what were we thinking?"
"Right. Let's go catch those extremist Zipfel followers, or check the administration zones."
The incident happened when the brothers, feeling suffocated, reeled in their fishing rods and sighed deeply.
It was right then.
"Uh, what?!"
"Crazy!"
The Tona brothers jumped up and pointed, and there was a small ship. It was different from the other fishing boats that were busy fishing in the waters near Tichin.
On the ship the brothers pointed to, there were not fishermen, but armed men.
There were twenty armed men on the ship.
The ship was very close to Tichin, and without any hesitation, the armed men drew their swords and started attacking the free city.
Shaaak, Kwaang, Kreeek......!
The magically fortified outer walls were being sliced and shattered like tofu by the sudden barrage of sword strikes.
"What the hell are they?!"
They couldn't immediately identify their affiliation.
However, as soon as the terror began, the brothers were sure that they were an assassination group composed of highly skilled fighters.
At least 7-stars, up to 9-stars. Maybe even more.
Where did they send those skilled fighters from? Mercenaries? There aren't many big mercenary groups like that. Is it the Zipfel? Or the Royal Family?
Whoever sent them, if they fought. Can we win?
We can't win. Also, strictly speaking, there is no reason to fight. We don't know what will happen if we get involved for no reason. The youngest has other colleagues in Tichin anyway.
All sorts of thoughts struck the brothers' minds in an instant.
Of course, the rational decision is to keep their place or retreat, but the Tona brothers shouted simultaneously.
"Let's go!"
Just being able to see the youngest meant that they could just fight for him without considering the gains and losses.

As they jumped onto the boat and headed towards Tichin, the brothers didn't even think that it could be an opportunity for them to 'look good' in front of the youngest. They were just determined to stop the attackers as quickly as possible.
They used the sword wind as propulsion. Since the distance was short, the brothers could quickly reach Tichin's outer walls.
They couldn't win the fight, they were sure of that before they arrived, but as the battle approached, a smile spread across the Tona brothers' faces.
The Saints didn't call the brothers 'Hell's Twins' for nothing.
"Heheh, hee. Stop, you bastards. Heheh, no. Just die!"
Daytona's eyes rolled as he shouted. At the same time, his swinging greatsword was aimed at the assassins who were about to enter Tichin.
Huuwoong-! Hwak!
The sword energy emanating from the greatsword heavily cut through the wind. At the same time, Heytona also unfolded his chain sword.

Both brothers were currently at 7-stars, but the sword energy enhanced by the unique brute force of Run Kandel was undoubtedly just as formidable as the swords of those who had achieved higher levels.
Five assassins were hit by the sword energy. The remaining fifteen had already entered Tichin and started battling with their comrades inside.
"Die!"
Daytona and Heytona unleashed their sword energy once again.
At their momentum, four of the five assassins hesitated for a moment. Blocking such sword energy on a swaying ship required tremendous skill in itself.
However, the four people didn't need to block the Tona brothers' sword energy.
The remaining one perfectly blocked it for them. He was the leader among the five remaining assassins outside the island.
Perhaps to hide their affiliations, all assassins were equipped with ordinary longswords.
"This wasn't part of the plan."
"What should we do?"
The leader and the assassins spoke.
They showed only a nonchalant reaction to the Tona brothers, who had appeared boldly. As if the brothers were insignificant and wouldn't make a difference.
As if they could decide whether to spare or kill them at their own discretion.
That was driving the Tona brothers crazy.
"What should we do, you say? You guys, did you just discuss what to do with us?"
"Heheh, standing in front of two Run Kandel riders... You seem so relaxed that it's insane. Moreover, the place you attacked is the stronghold of the 12th generation."
The Tona brothers shot sword energy again, but the leader easily dispersed it.
"Daytona Run Kandel and Heytona Run Kandel. I've heard you were foolish, but I didn't know it was this bad."
The leader shook his head.
"What?"
"Didn't you get a sense of it from the first clash? You guys can't stand a chance against me even if you come back from the dead."
The Tona brothers couldn't deny it.
"Ah, I got the sense. But why should that matter?"
"You seem to have no idea how precious life is. Even if you charge at me here and die, do you think the 12th generation would recognize you later?"
"Hehehe, are you saying you'll show mercy and tell us to quietly back down?"
"That's right."
"Unfortunately, someone recently reminded us that struggling against a stronger opponent is an essential virtue of Run Kandel. So we can't do that."

As the Tona brothers jumped up at the same time, the wooden boat shattered from their combined strength. They landed on the ship where the assassins were, and the Tona brothers' eyes glowed red with killing intent.
"If you insist on throwing away your chance to live, I won't stop you."
"It's been a while since we've crossed swords with people who aren't intimidated by the name Run Kandel."
"Come on in, heh! No, I'll go in!"
The moment Heytona and Daytona charged, the leader swung a single sword and pushed the brothers back, saying:
"I'll be the only one left outside. Finish up as quickly as possible and join us; you should join the people who have already entered."
The assassins scattered. The Tona brothers did not stop the assassins from entering Tichin. To be precise, they couldn't.
They knew that there was no answer to the leader who remained on the ship alone.
'Standing still, the pressure is tremendous... It's definitely someone from the 2nd generation or hired by the Elders Council. Where the hell did this guy come from?'

'With this level of martial artist, there must be at least a few more inside Tichin. If only one person could come out and reduce the number with Daytona, but looking at that guy's martial arts, it's difficult...'
What the Tona brothers hoped for was nothing else but endurance.
'Surely, the youngest will have heard that Tichin was attacked. We just have to hold out until then. If they come to the transfer gate, it'll be quick.'
Of course, their comrades inside Tichin could defeat the assassins and come out to support them.
However, the likelihood of that wasn't very high.
There were far more captain-level assassins heading inside, and other assassins could infiltrate through different routes. It was only natural.
The swords of the Tona brothers and the leader clashed, creating a thunderous noise.
With each blow received, the Tona brothers clenched their teeth, while the leader looked relaxed, as if playing with a toy.
"You're probably expecting the 12th generation or other forces to come to your aid."
In the midst of the ongoing offense and defense, the leader said while pointing at the sky. The clouds were unusually thick.
"You should know that the transfer gate cannot be used during heavy rain or snow."
Krrrrr-! Whooosh!
As soon as the leader finished speaking, lightning struck from the sky, and heavy rain began to pour.
"How... No way, did you control the weather?"
When Heytona asked while grinding his teeth, the leader shrugged his shoulders.
"Let's just say it's the realm of observation, prediction, and experience. At least for the next two days. After that time, neither you nor Tichin will exist in this world..."
Boom-!
In between the sound of the storm and the voice trying to drive the Tona brothers to despair.
Suddenly, a cry of a phantom beast was heard. It was the cry of Nundugubi Mot.
